comments.body: Erm this is weird. I had one of these jewellery trade+1 wizard clothes on the manequin and it seems like following one of the recent updates it got turned into a sorcerer's costume instead, with archaeo/theo/astro+2. Without a notice, needless to say.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: I have a pair of Wizard Robes that I won during a Halloween event, and I can honestly say that their +1 Jewel Trading skill remains unchanged. I'm sure that if any *other* Wizard Robe items had suddenly changed overnight... like, say, during the King Minos patch? It would've been reported right away. Who would want their previous, largely useless collector item Robes to be turned into a coveted rare bottle drop item with vastly better stats and a new name to boot? Maybe you've just been out to sea too long, mate. ;)
